title: Joint Service Depth and Priority Design in Queueing Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.33334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In AI-assisted service systems, the server can choose how much processing effort to spend on each job, which we call the service depth. Deeper reasoning improves output quality but occupies the server longer and increases congestion, and the realized processing time remains random because AI models are probabilistic and tasks vary in complexity. We study the joint design of service depth and priority in a single-server queue whose customers differ in delay sensitivity, with the goal of maximizing social welfare. For each customer type, the decision maker chooses a priority level and a service depth, and service times are exponential with mean equal to the chosen depth. With two customer types and linear service values, we characterize the centralized optimum. translated_title: 排队系统中的服务深度与优先级联合设计
translated_abstract: 在AI辅助的服务系统中，服务器可以选择对每个任务投入多少处理力度，我们称之为服务深度。更深度的推理能提升输出质量，但会占用服务器更长时间并加剧拥堵，而且由于AI模型具有概率性、任务复杂度各不相同，实际处理时间仍然是随机的。我们研究了单服务器排队系统中服务深度与优先级的联合设计问题，其中顾客的延迟敏感度各不相同，目标是最 大化社会福利。对于每种顾客类型，决策者选择一个优先级和一个服务深度，服务时间服从指数分布，其均值等于所选的服务深度。在两类顾客且服务价值为线性的情形下，我们刻画了集中式最优解。与直觉相反，当耐心型顾客足够多时，最优策略会优先服务耐心型顾客，并给予其更小的服务深度。而当延迟敏感度属于私人信息时，……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文刻画了AI辅助排队系统中服务深度与优先级的联合最优设计，发现当耐心型顾客足够多时，最优策略反直觉地优先服务耐心型顾客并给予其更小的服务深度。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the joint optimal design of service depth and priority in AI-assisted queueing systems, showing the counterintuitive result that when patient customers are sufficiently prevalent, the optimal policy prioritizes them with a smaller service depth.
